description: Get the KBB Instant Cash Offer link for a store — this is how a customer gets a REAL dollar amount for their trade. Use this whenever someone asks what their vehicle is worth, or after get_trade_in_value returns a condition assessment without a price. Pass the store the customer is working with (SAV/STA/HIN/POO/MAZ, or a city name); Lincoln routes to Statesboro. The customer completes KBB's own flow and receives a redeemable Instant Cash Offer certificate. IMPORTANT: never quote or guess a trade-in dollar amount yourself — we cannot generate one. Hand them the link and be straightforward that KBB is where the number comes from.
name: get_trade_in_link
